headline: Colombia Public Debt Reaches $1.2 Trillion, Equalling 62.2% of GDP in October
summary: Colombia's total gross public debt rose to $1.2 trillion in October, representing 62.2% of gross domestic product and increasing by $20 billion year-on-year.
why: Sovereign debt-to-GDP ratios are key metrics for credit rating agencies and bond investors evaluating fiscal sustainability and emerging market default risks.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Higher public debt ratios increase sovereign fiscal vulnerability.
